en.headline: Kai Tak family clinic sees nearly 300 patients on opening morning
en.dek: The hospital’s chief executive told the South China Morning Post the daily load is projected to reach 1,800 by the end of the year.
body: Kai Tak Hospital’s family medicine centre treated nearly 300 patients on Monday morning, the first day of its phased opening, the South China Morning Post reported.

The hospital’s chief executive told the paper that the daily number of patients is projected to reach 1,800 by the end of the year. The Family Medicine Integrated Centre is taking patients with stable chronic conditions and mild one-off illnesses. Patients began arriving at the specialist outpatient block from 8:30am, with volunteers directing them, the report said.

Lawmakers quoted by the paper called for more frequent connecting transport and clearer publicity on how to reach the site. The hospital is intended to become Hong Kong’s largest public hospital once it is fully open.

The Hospital Authority had earlier said the centre would offer about 350 family-medicine appointments a day at launch. Specialist outpatient and blood-taking services are due to start in batches later this month.

zh.headline: 啟德家庭醫學中心首早應診近300人
zh.dek: 醫院行政總監向《南華早報》表示，預計年底每日病人量可達1800人。
body: 《南華早報》報道，啟德醫院家庭醫學中心星期一早上、即分階段啟用首日，應診近300名病人。
醫院行政總監向該報表示，預計年底每日病人量可達1800人。家庭醫學綜合中心目前接收病情穩定的長期病患者及輕微偶發病症。報道指，病人由早上8時半起到達專科門診大樓，有義工在場指路。
報道引述立法會議員呼籲加強接駁交通班次，並把前往醫院的交通資訊說得更清楚。醫院全面運作後，定位為本港最大的公立醫院。
醫院管理局較早時表示，中心啟用初期每日約有350個家庭醫學名額。專科門診及抽血服務預計本月稍後分批開展。
